verdict.rationale: Docs show table_format outputs markdown/html (not typed JSON) and document_annotation/bbox_annotation can return document-level JSON per a user-provided schema, which a data engineer could use to get structured fields, but there's no dedicated feature for converting extracted tables specifically into typed rows/columns ready for DB load — markdown/html tables still need parsing/cleanup. Community evidence focuses on general OCR accuracy, not table-to-JSON fidelity. Missing for 10: a built-in table-to-typed-JSON/row schema specifically for tabular data, and independent evidence that table extraction into structured records works reliably without manual cleanup.
